name: tasks-agent
purpose: Lean specialist copy of the orchestrator: zero extensions, zero skills, no Telegram bridge, no git automation, instructions from the user only. Token usage of every turn is recorded in its own ledger by a user timer and served on :8791. Google Tasks via `gog tasks` (lists, add, done, undo, update, delete).
